title: Chapter 260 Short Peace Ii
content:
Chapter 260 Short Peace Ii

In the past six months, the world has gradually recovered its calm, and the pain caused by the war has gradually disappeared. All the local people have returned to their hometowns and started a new round of rebuilding their homes.

Counties and counties across the Seven Kingdoms, with the reappointment of local officials, slowly established and strengthened the foundation of governance, and also fell into the midst of full-fledged production recovery.

However, in such a scene of rare post-war peace, there is indeed an unknown undercurrent surging.

The former leader of the alliance, the former head of the Hezong Yuguo, his position was lost with the defeat of the Qin State and the dissolution of the alliance, and gradually faded out of the eyes of the people of the world.

However, now it seems that the former alliance leader seems a little unwilling to withdraw from the stage of the world. Instead, he sent his envoys everywhere, and wanted to perform a new play on the stage of the world.

The envoys sent by Yuguo first contacted South Korea and Yanguo. These two countries had been notified before the war, and they had a certain idea in mind, so they agreed to this alliance reorganization without hesitation.

Among them, the country of Yan was the most important. As soon as the envoy arrived, the king of Yan immediately agreed and issued an order to prepare the whole country for war. The country of Yan, which had finally settled down, fell into pre-war mobilization again, causing panic among the people.

The same is true for South Korea. Although South Korea is the weakest among the countries, most of the people in his country are Korean survivors who have just recovered their lost land.

These Korean immigrants have been away from South Korea for a long time. Although they say that South Korea is very close and they still have some memories of South Korea, they are very unfamiliar after all. To be honest, they don't agree with South Korea's rule.

South Korea is surrounded by the state of Zhao in the north, the state of Wei in the east, the state of Chu in the south, and the state of Qin that South Korea has just offended in the west. It can be said that it is surrounded by tigers and wolves, surrounded by powerful enemies, and there is a possibility of being invaded by the enemy at any time.

In such a situation of internal and external troubles, if the king of Han wants to maintain his rule, he must have the intervention and support of external forces, and what external force is the best? Naturally, it was the leader of the Royal Kingdom who had cooperated happily before.

So South Korea agreed to this condition very happily, and King Han was quite active, because he understood that if the alliance was formed again, then its three countries in the north, south, east, and east would once again become an alliance, and the three countries of Zhao, Wei, and Chu would evolve into an alliance. Without allies, it is impossible to threaten his border security.

Without these threats, King Han will be able to concentrate all his forces on the border of Qin State and actively resist Qin State's aggression.

With such a layer of guarantee, at least South Korea will not have any worries about extinction while the alliance is still maintained. How could King Han refuse such a powerful protective umbrella so easily!

The actions of the Han and Yan countries were quickly detected by interested people in the world, which aroused their vigilance and panic.

It has only been half a year since the turmoil in the world subsided, Han and Yan countries started to mobilize the whole country again, recruited all the men, and put on a posture of a national war, how can they not surprise the people of the world?

You must know that the pain of war is best known to Yan and Han!

Because of the war, Yan State lost half of its territory and population, and also lost 100,000 elites in the battle with Qin State, which can be described as a heavy loss.

South Korea is even worse. The country's elite army has been completely destroyed, leaving only a few thousand people. Although the remaining army has reorganized more than 100,000 people, they are all recruits, and their loyalty to South Korea is not very high. , there is a possibility of mutiny at any time.

Under such a situation, the two countries actually ignored the possible turmoil and put on an appearance of desperately fighting with someone, which aroused the vigilance of the neighboring countries of the two countries.

The surrounding countries of the two countries also inexplicably gathered their troops to deal with possible wars.

What made them even more vigilant was the intelligence that came from them secretly. According to the spies' reports, before the two countries made such an action, their respective kings summoned the envoys of the imperial kingdom, and after a secret talk, they took this action.

This has aroused the deep thinking of countries and major forces.

What exactly did Yuguo say to these two countries? It actually aroused their strong will and desire to fight, even in the face of the crisis of destroying the country, they had to mobilize like this, forcibly violated the will of the people in the world, and launched a war that swept the world again. frenzied.

You know, the entire world today has long been tired of it because of the three years of war in the past.

During this great war, more than 5 million people in the whole world died because of this, and countless people were displaced because of it.

It can be said that the soldiers of all countries have no will to fight, and they will no longer have the will to fight. The common people are tired of being soldiers and endless deaths. The generals and ministers entered the stage of digestion because of the enough land and wealth they had just plundered, and they didn't care about others.

Under such circumstances, anyone who dares and tries to provoke a war will face their crusade and disgust.

Han Yanyu's actions in the Three Kingdoms can be said to be acting at the risk of violating the wishes of the people of the world and arousing the anger of the people of the world.

However, just when the world was once again in panic and all countries were secretly on alert, the envoys of the imperial kingdom went to the palaces of the three kingdoms of Zhao, Wei and Chu again, requesting to meet their kings.

Needless to say, this mission is also an invitation to them to join the alliance again.

For this invitation, the three countries have different attitudes.

Let’s talk about the Zhao Kingdom in the north first. Today’s Zhao Kingdom has restored the previously lost territory, except for one Yunzhong County, which fell into the hands of Yuguo, and now it has been entrusted to those generals with meritorious service, forming several princes abroad. Others Most of the territory has been recovered, and even slightly expanded.

However, the geographical location of the care can be said to be very delicate. Its north is the Xiongnu, the south is South Korea and Wei, the west is Qin, and the northeast and east are Yu. It is surrounded by countless countries, and the only ally among them can be regarded as an ally, and the only one who can be trusted is the Wei country who has experienced adversity!

But the strength of Wei State is too small after all, even in the whole world, among all countries, Wei State's strength can be ranked among the top four.

But Wei Guo also has his own enemies. The east is strong, and Qi Guo has not lost any strength due to the war. The territory in the south is vast, and in this battle, countless territories of Chu were expanded. And South Korea, which is weak in the west but has become the dog's leg of Yuguo, is threatening him!

With all these concerns, the amount of aid Wei Guo can send must not be very large, only a few hundred thousand, and even 100,000 is enough!

So facing the alliance's invitation to rebuild again, Zhao Wang just hesitated for a while, and reluctantly agreed.

King Zhao's behavior cannot be blamed for being weak and spineless. It can only be blamed that his surroundings are all within the radiating range of Yuguo's influence, subject to Yuguo, that's the only way!
